expected_behavior: Writes a short ops/premortem.md in proportion to a one-job CI change that reverts in one commit and is not a required check for two weeks.

Names the ordinary ways it misfires (the script's grep misses a reworded heading, a docs-only PR that also touches cmd/, people adding a filler line, the no-changelog label becoming a habit) and the one-commit revert.
Proposes no staged trial, shadow run, mirror repository, scratch-clone check with a stop rule, dashboard, or sign-off gate.
